requirements.approved_text: NTFS, ReFS, FAT32 and exFAT are within scope; capability uncertainty is explicitly downgraded or rejected.
requirements.scope_note: Both modes target NTFS/ReFS/FAT32/exFAT subject to live checks. Overwrite requires supported storage evidence; ReFS and special-file states can require explicit delete-only grants. Quick does not overwrite and may conservatively group unknown physical topology. Filesystem scope is not a passed device matrix.

requirements.approved_text: Do not follow symbolic links or junctions; never overwrite shared hard-link data.
requirements.scope_note: Reparse ancestors and final components are rejected in both modes. Quick removes selected namespace entries only; overwrite never writes shared hard-link data. The later Quick alias contract differs from overwrite identity deduplication; see R44.

requirements.approved_text: Protect Windows, boot, recovery, system-service resources and important filesystem metadata.
requirements.scope_note: OS/service/boot/recovery/private-state tree protection remains fail-closed. Self-protection pins the running EXE and loaded modules by exact path/file identity and protects containing selected ancestors; unrelated executable-directory siblings are permitted.

requirements.approved_text: Attempt graceful lock release first; each forced process termination requires separate confirmation.
requirements.scope_note: Quick automatic access/lock recovery waits for the entire first pass and never force-terminates. Manual GUI/CLI process release uses fresh target/PID/creation-time/image evidence; force is independently authorized per unprotected user process.

requirements.approved_text: Select the best-effort strategy from actual storage-media and filesystem capabilities.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite selects only supported media/filesystem strategies and reports capability limitations. Quick media facts guide scheduling, not overwrite assurance; unknown physical topology is grouped conservatively without relaxing identity/protection checks. No best-on-all-hardware performance claim.

requirements.approved_text: Process every accessible alternate data stream; report stream enumeration/access failures explicitly.
requirements.scope_note: Applies to verified overwrite: enumerate and process admitted accessible streams, reporting failures. Quick performs namespace deletion without payload stream enumeration, overwrite or readback.

requirements.approved_text: Default to one pass of cryptographically secure pseudorandom overwrite data.
requirements.scope_note: Applies to overwrite mode. The later explicit Quick mode performs logical deletion without a payload pass and does not claim equivalent erasure assurance.

requirements.approved_text: Flush then read back all overwritten bytes and compare against the exact expected stream.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite flushes and compares all expected bytes before deletion; a read-success check alone is insufficient. Quick has no content-verification phase. Explicitly authorized delete-only targets are reported as such rather than verified overwrites.

requirements.approved_text: Use the native Windows TRIM path when applicable; never equate acceptance with physical sanitization.
requirements.scope_note: Applies to overwrite where the backend admits native TRIM. Acceptance is not proof of NAND erasure; Quick does not add a file-content/TRIM workflow.

requirements.approved_text: Stop the affected operation on failure and retain truthful partial state.
requirements.scope_note: Per-target failures and affected-device faults retain partial state. Quick resource or audit-storage failure can stop later work after earlier deletions; untouched targets retain quick_not_attempted and a separate stopping_error. Unknown completion never authorizes an automatic new scan.

requirements.approved_text: Process a batch per file, skip failed items, and remove directories only when empty.
requirements.scope_note: Quick schedules a directory as its own child dependencies settle; overwrite completes file workers before deepest-first directory work. Neither recursively consumes additions discovered at deletion time, and nonempty directories remain failures.

requirements.approved_text: Maximize speed only within unchanged safety and complete-verification guarantees.
requirements.scope_note: Safety and required verification constrain overwrite optimization. The later Quick mode deliberately has logical-delete semantics, so its speed is not compared as an equivalent verified erase. No universal maximum-speed claim is supported.

requirements.approved_text: Assess synchronous/overlapped I/O, caching and alignment according to the device.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite uses buffered write-through I/O, positioned overlapped SSD operations and synchronous HDD/USB operations. Each overlapped operation is awaited; neither a per-file multi-request pipeline nor FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING/alignment optimization is claimed.

requirements.approved_text: Group work by physical storage device and dynamically bound each device's concurrency.
requirements.scope_note: Quick groups shared physical extents, conservatively groups unknown topology and tunes per-group concurrency through measured probes/rollback/cooldown. Overwrite uses supported-device keys, HDD/USB depth one, configurable SSD depth 1–4 and a pressure-limited global worker pool; it does not use the Quick throughput tuner.

requirements.approved_text: Use bounded buffers and allow a configurable global memory ceiling.
requirements.scope_note: Quick uses file-backed target strings/outcomes and resource-admitted resident metadata proportional to target count; there is no fixed 100000-target or 16-worker Quick ceiling. Caller limits can lower live budgets, and an oversized complete plan is refused. Overwrite retains a resident plan, explicit buffer/metadata accounting and format/size bounds. Neither budget is a total process RSS cap covering allocator, GUI, OS cache or driver memory.

requirements.approved_text: Choose overwrite block size from device characteristics, alignment and measurements.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite transfer latency adapts chunks between 64 KiB and the configured ceiling (up to 8 MiB). Device/alignment-specific optimal block selection is not fully established by this implementation or current hardware evidence; that part of the approved performance target remains open.

requirements.approved_text: Support pause, cancel and durable checkpoints; revalidate target identity before resume.
requirements.scope_note: Durable authenticated checkpoints and identity/content-validated resume apply to overwrite. Quick pause/continuation retains the same live staged store; external reports or a restarted process are not Quick resume authority. Both modes retain truthful partial/cancelled outcomes.

requirements.approved_text: Dynamically limit CPU, I/O and queued work according to system load.
requirements.scope_note: Quick periodically samples memory/commit/CPU/handle/device pressure, adjusts admitted concurrency and can stop when resource/topology revalidation fails. Overwrite uses CPU/RAM pressure, per-device queues, bounded chunks and an optional shared bandwidth limiter. Neither provides system-global CPU/I/O scheduling control.

requirements.approved_text: Use Dear ImGui, Win32 and DirectX 11 in a single native GUI window.
requirements.scope_note: The owner reported GUI Quick/overwrite smoke success. Hosted native CI and test-source presence are not desktop GUI acceptance for every supported Windows build.

requirements.approved_text: Ship distinct GUI and CLI executables backed by the same core library.
requirements.scope_note: GUI and CLI share native plan/execution/backend contracts while retaining interface-specific orchestration. CLI is machine-only and does not load a GUI runtime or require MCP. Owner CLI Agent acceptance remains pending.

requirements.approved_text: Preview every frozen target, size and risk before confirming the whole batch.
requirements.scope_note: The later Agent CLI amendment allows authorized run to prepare and execute one scoped manifest request without per-file prompts or a mandatory separate scan invocation. GUI exposes the frozen batch before confirmation. Quick scan is advisory; overwrite scan can preserve a protected plan. Every execution still freezes complete membership before mutation.

requirements.approved_text: CLI defaults to preview and requires an explicit irreversible-operation confirmation argument.
requirements.scope_note: Superseded CLI default: no arguments return capabilities, not preview. scan is explicit; run/resume require --authorize-irreversible plus the scoped request contract. Independent downgrade/process-force permissions remain separate.

requirements.approved_text: GUI supports drag/drop, file/directory pickers, queue, pause, cancel, resume and history.
requirements.scope_note: GUI has queued input names for one current batch, drag/drop/pickers, control actions and available history. This is not a multi-job service. Durable resume applies to overwrite; Quick continuation is limited to its live staged job.

requirements.approved_text: Show file/batch progress, throughput, ETA, failure counts and device statistics.
requirements.scope_note: Progress is mode-specific: overwrite supplies write/verify bytes, rates and estimates; Quick supplies namespace counters, observed rates and allocation/free-space hints. Compact Quick reports page disk outcomes; an empty resident targets vector does not mean no targets or no failures.

requirements.approved_text: Emit JSONL with stable event codes, Win32/NTSTATUS context and path masking.
requirements.scope_note: Win32/HRESULT values are retained where available; no fabricated NTSTATUS is claimed. Retained engine event logs and GUI diagnostic snapshots mask paths. Explicitly requested private CLI manifests/reports can contain paths and have a distinct disclosure scope; compact stdout is not the full audit report.

requirements.approved_text: Use a currently supported MSVC toolchain discovered in VS2022 or VS2026 installations.
Prefer Ninja/CMake and verified C++ named modules.
requirements.scope_note: Owned public APIs use genuine C++ named modules; private engine partitions encapsulate admission and execution. Every authored C++ unit imports the vendor std module. CMake scanning builds actual BMIs. External SDK/third-party headers remain at explicit boundaries. See current module checker output and per-run native evidence for current counts/results.

requirements.approved_text: Use /std:c++latest; rely only on compiler/library facilities demonstrated to work.
requirements.scope_note: MSVC uses actual /std:c++latest. The locked CMake 4.5 upstream snapshot automatically discovers the vendor std module. Its current MSVC mapping uses standard metadata23; future native26 metadata is selected when it maps to latest. A real import std compile/link probe is mandatory. Portable Clang21 C++26 evidence is separate from native MSVC results.

requirements.approved_text: Release only with /O2 /GL /LTCG /MT; enable PGO only after supported testing.
requirements.scope_note: PGO remains off until a measured training/validation run exists.

requirements.approved_text: Maintain x64 baseline compatibility and dispatch CPU-specific operations at runtime.
requirements.scope_note: Portable scalar x64 baseline plus Windows CNG system entropy; no unsupported AVX baseline or untested custom SIMD dispatch.

requirements.approved_text: BAT/CMake automatically discover PATH tools first, then regular MSVC/SDK/tool installation paths.
Pin dependency versions and hashes and support cached/offline rebuilds.
Use UTF-8 BOM for authored source; honor standard-format UTF-8 exceptions; deliver Source ZIP.
Validate Windows 10 1809 and representative Windows 10/11 builds; distinguish expected from tested support.
requirements.scope_note: Historical Windows 10/1809 scope is superseded by the owner-approved Windows 11+ x64 target, minimum build 22000, in spec/project.json. Hosted Server 2025 CI is separately scoped native evidence, not proof that every targeted Windows 11 build or toolchain combination passed.

requirements.approved_text: Maintain a filesystem and HDD/SSD/USB capability/test matrix; downgrade or reject unsupported cases.
requirements.scope_note: The physical HDD/SSD/USB and NTFS/ReFS/FAT32/exFAT matrix remains incomplete. Overwrite rejects unsupported virtual/remote/unknown/multi-disk storage evidence. Quick still requires supported local filesystem/protection/identity checks but can conservatively group unknown physical topology; it makes no overwrite assurance.

requirements.approved_text: Grade outcomes by verifiable evidence, residual risks and incomplete operations.
requirements.scope_note: Logical namespace deletion, verified overwrite, residual risk and partial/unknown completion are distinct outcomes. Shared blocks, hard links, open handles and other activity mean observed allocation/free-space changes are not attributable reclaimed-byte guarantees.

requirements.approved_text: Run fault and destructive tests only on dedicated test data/VMs/disposable media.
requirements.scope_note: Native destructive fixtures create isolated disposable data and are opt-in; CI passed four isolated suites at the recorded source. This does not authorize cleanup of repository/user data or substitute for the remaining physical-media matrix.

requirements.approved_text: System-resource protection is fail-closed: uncertainty rejects the target.
requirements.scope_note: Unknown identity or system-protection evidence rejects mutation. Unknown Quick scheduling topology is an optimization uncertainty handled by conservative grouping, not unknown protection status; overwrite storage capability rules are stricter.

requirements.approved_text: Release needs all required tests passing; incomplete platform compatibility validation permits only RC.
requirements.scope_note: Normal owner evidence/review gates remain. Published Latest v2.0.0 is the explicit first-distribution owner exception in docs/publication.md, not a claim that pending CLI/hardware cases passed and not authorization for a later Release.

requirements.approved_text: Deliver source ZIP, build scripts, locked dependencies, tests and machine-readable acceptance evidence.
requirements.scope_note: Source packaging supplies an exact-commit archive, manifest/checksums and build/test sources; runtime acceptance artifacts remain external, not tracked per-run reports. The published v2.0.0 runtime ZIP is a different deliverable containing unchanged owner EXEs, instructions, Skill, schemas and licenses; source/build/test files remain in Git.

requirements.approved_text: Revalidate handles, volume/file identity and attributes; reject inconsistent targets.
requirements.scope_note: Both modes validate held selected-name identity and safety state before mutation. Overwrite also binds streams, sizes, timestamps and capabilities; Quick has no payload-stream verification requirement. Same-path replacements are rejected, not adopted.

requirements.approved_text: Before resume, validate identity, size, streams, timestamps and checkpoint state.
requirements.scope_note: Durable overwrite resume revalidates checkpoint metadata and saved written prefixes; possible post-verification TRIM causes a fresh full overwrite/verification before completion. Quick has only the separately bound live-session continuation contract.

requirements.approved_text: Temporarily adjust attributes only on approved non-system targets and restore them where possible.
requirements.scope_note: Readonly adjustment/restoration is handle-bound. Overwrite checkpoint snapshots restore attributes before persistence. Native fixture sources cover restoration and self-protection cases; their hosted execution scope does not establish every filesystem/hardware behavior.

requirements.approved_text: Deduplicate by identity and do not overwrite hard-link shared data.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite keeps identity deduplication: multiple selected aliases collapse to one deterministic name, remaining aliases survive with reported risk and can keep directories nonempty. The later Quick namespace amendment retains different selected hard-link names as separate deletions, deduplicates repeated names and never overwrites shared data.

requirements.approved_text: Analyze special-file capabilities, then choose overwrite, explicitly authorized downgrade deletion, or refusal with evidence.
requirements.scope_note: Applies to overwrite capability handling; compressed/sparse/encrypted/ReFS/shared-link states may require explicit delete-only grants or refusal. Quick is a separately selected logical-delete mode, not an automatic downgrade from overwrite.

requirements.approved_text: On storage-device or filesystem fault, stop affected device work and retain isolated diagnostics.
requirements.scope_note: Detected storage faults stop affected-device work and retain diagnostics. Quick may stop the whole job when shared staging/audit/resource evidence becomes unreliable; this can follow completed deletions and must remain partial/unknown, not a pre-mutation refusal claim.

requirements.approved_text: Overwrite/verify accessible resident data streams; report historical MFT/journal remnants as unguaranteed.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite covers accessible admitted logical streams, including resident streams; historical filesystem records/journal entries are not sanitized. Quick performs no payload overwrite.

requirements.approved_text: Use versioned built-in protection rules plus runtime identification; reject unknown protection status.
requirements.scope_note: Runtime-protected image inventory includes exact running EXE/module paths and file identities, with containing directory protection; unrelated siblings are allowed. Failure to resolve mandatory protection evidence refuses mutation. OS/service/boot/private-state policies remain independent.

requirements.approved_text: Force-terminate only clearly identified, unprotected user processes, with confirmation for each process.
requirements.scope_note: Forced termination uses a fresh target key, PID, creation time and image binding and rejects protected/uncertain processes. Neither ordinary batch authorization nor Quick automatic recovery is force permission. CLI requires an independent force flag; GUI requires the separate action confirmation.

requirements.approved_text: Checkpoint storage requires integrity, restricted access, atomic updates and version compatibility.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite DPAPI state has integrity protection, restricted access, atomic replacement and schema checks, not anti-rollback against the same principal/SYSTEM. Fresh consent, identity checks and content verification still apply. Quick protected scratch is live-session storage, not a durable imported checkpoint.

requirements.approved_text: Downgrade deletion needs extra confirmation, including a separate CLI authorization.
requirements.scope_note: Applies to overwrite delete-only fallback. Separate per-target capability grants are required by CLI/GUI; selecting Quick explicitly is a different authorized logical-delete workflow, not a silent downgrade.

requirements.approved_text: Do not modify snapshots or backups; detect identifiable retained-copy risks and report them.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite performs read-only completed VSS snapshot inventory with explicit complete/count/error; provider failure is unknown, not zero. Quick does not run that inventory. Neither mode removes snapshots/backups or completely inventories arbitrary offline/cloud copies.

requirements.approved_text: Freeze the target set during preview; revalidate identity at execution; never process additions or replacements.
requirements.scope_note: GUI preview and protected overwrite resume keep their exact frozen plan. The later CLI run contract can prepare and execute a newly authorized scoped manifest in one invocation, but completes freezing before any mutation; a prior Quick scan is advisory rather than execution/retry authority. No execution adds or substitutes targets.

requirements.approved_text: List downgrade targets and obtain independent preview authorization; reconfirm changed execution capabilities.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite capability changes reject the old approval and require repreview/fresh explicit consent; no silent downgrade. Quick is separately authorized as logical deletion and does not reuse an overwrite downgrade grant.

requirements.approved_text: Use a bounded reproducible cryptographic data stream; protect sensitive state and verify its integrity.
requirements.scope_note: Overwrite uses Windows cryptographic randomness, reproducible ChaCha20 data and domain-separated segment derivation for 64-bit offsets. Protected checkpoints contain keys/nonces/cursors; full verification regenerates expected content. Quick has no overwrite random-data requirement.

requirements.approved_text: Restrict log/checkpoint access, allow configurable retention, remove completed checkpoints and rotate logs by policy.
requirements.scope_note: Incomplete overwrite checkpoints default to no expiry until completion or explicitly configured expiry; logs default to 30 days and eight 4 MiB files. Quick scratch disappears when its live owner closes; durable external reports have a separate lifecycle. ACLs are not a boundary against a compromised same user/SYSTEM.

requirements.approved_text: All necessary unit/integration/isolated destructive tests must pass; without platform measurements deliver at most RC.
requirements.scope_note: Hosted native CI at the recorded source passed 11 safe and four isolated suites plus source packaging; per-case gaps and the full owner hardware/CLI matrix remain pending. Published v2.0.0 follows only the explicit first-distribution exception; normal later-version gates are unchanged.

current_validation_location: CI artifacts and release evidence, never a tracked per-run report

interpretation.approved_text: Preserved historical decision text; current scope notes and later explicit owner amendments explain superseded platform/interface contracts without removing the decision.
interpretation.implementation_status: source_locations_recorded is a traceability statement, not a claim that every approved behavior or platform has passed acceptance.
interpretation.validation_status: scoped_evidence_available_acceptance_incomplete refers to the current evidence summary; listed test files are sources, not per-requirement pass results.
interpretation.performance: Adaptive algorithms are implemented heuristics. Alignment/device tuning and hardware-optimal throughput remain measurement targets, not verified guarantees.

current_validation_scope.owner: GUI quick-deletion and overwrite smoke reported successful; CLI Agent acceptance and full hardware matrix pending.
